To build this, `/` would have to be absorbed

This is the general mechanism of LEFT

nest inside another member's right operand.
The printer agrees, and that agreement is
the check. `display.rs` writes reading A as
Parser and printer partition the two
, so it is NOT absorbed here
`/` re-enters the OUTER loop and takes

`*` opens the multiplicative level; `/` and `%` carry the `same` annotation,

— an UNANNOTATED rule binds tighter than
the one before it, and a `same`-annotated rule ties with it.
